title: The Secret Reason Coconut Water Is a Natural Isotonic

scenes.text: Did you know a single coconut can hydrate you like a sports drink?
Coconut water contains about 600 mg of potassium per cup, matching blood plasma levels.
Its natural sodium‑to‑potassium ratio is close to the body’s own, preventing electrolyte imbalance.
That’s why sailors used fresh coconuts to stay hydrated on long voyages.

description: Coconut water isn’t just tasty—it’s a natural isotonic that matches your body’s fluids. Discover the sailor’s secret and why it’s perfect hydration. Hit follow for more everyday science mysteries!
